Iris K (Finance): FYI invoice 99823 for BetaPulse just failed ACH verification this morning. Bank returned ACH_RTNN02 (account not found). We need to confirm wiring details or offer card.
Noah G (BillingOps): Checking the customer recordthey only had ACH on file. No fallback card. Customer is on net-45. Any previous history?
Tina S (CS): Customer replied to my note: their AP team changed banks last week but didn't update us. They can wire today if we provide wire instructions.
Iris K (Finance): Wire OK but we must provide exact beneficiary and add our internal invoice reference. Use secure email for full routing.
bank-bot: ACH failure event: {"code":"ACH_RTNN02","amount":"1500000","currency":"usd"} (posted)
Noah G (BillingOps): Proposed flow: 1) mark invoice 99823 as "awaiting payment - wire pending"; 2) email secure wire template to AP; 3) allow service until COB tomorrow; 4) if no payment, apply access restriction. Any objections?
Tina S (CS): Allowing till COB sounds good. I'll send the secure wire email and confirm ETA. Will ask if they can provide remittance advice after sending.
Iris K (Finance): Also flag as high-risk for future billing. Finance to follow up about applying card on file as fallback. Noah, add note: "ACH failed - customer to wire; monitor clearing".
Noah G (BillingOps): Done. Updated invoice 99823 status and added internal note. Sent wire instructions template via encrypted email to AP.
Tina S (CS): Update: AP responded, they'll initiate wire today, ETA 2 business days. Requested our full beneficiary name and invoice reference. I confirmed via secure channel.
Iris K (Finance): Good. Keep monitoring and close when funds show. If wire bounces, we'll request card and escalate. Thanks.
